newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's NSW closes No 1 barley pool.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's NSW closes No 1 barley pool.

text.p: The New South Wales Grains Board said on Monday it had closed all Number One harvest pools for barley and opened the number Two pools.
The action was taken to protect prices of barley already delivered, the board said in a statement.
The barley harvest is virtually completed, it said.
"Now we want to isolate grower returns for barley that already has been delivered from any future downward movements in the market by closing them," the board said.
The Number Two pools will cater for grain that has been held off the market so far by growers making their own marketing decisions, the board said.
"Forecasts for the Number Two pools are below the net returns forecast for the Number One pools by between A$5 and A$19 per tonne," it said.
